input: Find founder- or family-owned US veterinary clinic groups with 5-30 locations

companies.name: R Veterinary
companies.traction: R Veterinary states that it has grown from one clinic in 2016 to ten clinics across Missouri. The homepage lists ten locations: Lake of the Ozarks, Laurie, Cross Creek, Columbia, All Creatures - Bolivar, Ashland, Westside, Romaine Creek, Kirbyville, and R Veterinary at Lebanon. As of observation 2026-11-09. Source: https://www.r.vet/about
companies.rank_reason: Strongest explicit ownership disclosure: 100% owned by the founding Rericha family, expressly rejects private equity, with ten Missouri clinics.

criteria_evidence.evidence: 10 veterinary locations in the United States; current website observed 2026-11-09. Published page date not stated.
criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group; 5–30 operating locations

criteria_evidence.evidence: The company states it is 100% family-owned, was built by a veterinarian and her family, and identifies Dr. Katie Rericha and James Rericha as founders and owners. Ownership statements observed 2026-11-09.
criteria_evidence.criterion: Founder- or family-owned; no PE ownership

output.search_notes: Research cutoff: 2026-11-09. Six verified qualifying groups are ranked by strength of ownership evidence and operating-location fit, not estimated enterprise value. Counts from undated current pages are labeled by observation date, not represented as dated company disclosures. This is a verified public-source set, not a guarantee of an exhaustive US census. Unverified private/founder-led ownership alone was not accepted. No two comparable dated total-headcount observations or latest equity rounds were verified; null means unavailable, not zero growth or no financing. Employee profile counts, where shown, may materially undercount hospital workforces. Current company location directories take precedence over older profiles. PE portfolio checks were not comprehensive; the list relies on explicit present-day founder/family ownership disclosures rather than absence of acquisition news. Missing fields are listed per company in criteria_evidence.
